objective: Pivot the local commerce SaaS into a multi-purpose website builder with website types, customizable themes, structured pages and blogging while preserving existing stores
acceptance_criteria: Users can create business, portfolio, blog, landing, online-store, agency and other websites with appropriate themes
Dashboard adapts to website type; pages and posts can be created, edited, previewed, published and unpublished
Structured section editor supports ordering, visibility and custom content with shared responsive rendering
Draft content stays private until publication; tenant/role/URL validation and concurrent edit protections hold
Non-commerce sites and blog articles have working public routes and metadata; stores retain all existing commerce flows
Additive migration preserves existing local data; PostgreSQL/SQLite migration checks, backend/browser tests and production build pass
non_goals: Free-form canvas unless user steers that choice
